review_mode: Independent read-only exact source and transitive composition review; no builds or edits
findings: entry_resources produces one gas/e prefix witness, actual selected Lambda/context evaluation equality, initializer Domain and child gas sufficiency. Collision is checked in the nonce-incremented child world; changing nominal gas/e to the selected witness is definitionally irrelevant to that collision predicate.

JournalGuarantees.initializes derives actual successful initialization and Invariant kind 0 w from exact initializer bytes, derived Domain/resources and explicit canonical-address equality. No child success, initializer output, or desired final invariant is supplied as an input.

The proof rewrites that produced result through the selected child eval equality, obtaining the exact CreationGas.child(create2,steps+2) tuple with the same created/world/returned-gas/substate and empty successful output. Salt and initializer are the actual full calldata-derived values.

FactoryPrefixGas applies to the same retained prefix witness; charged gas is proven gas-createCost using hg. Entry gas<=2^64 therefore derives the literal CREATE2 WORD-guard ceiling; ReturnedGas-derived child return bounds supply settlement success.

The continuation reserve is derived from actual forwarded child gas sufficiency and settlement reserve charged/64, yielding at least 200 gas; it does not assume a tail success or assume that the initializer returns a positive amount of gas.

post_shape is a definitional equality for both kinds between actual successfulPost and the tail start, including world, created set, full substate, memory, activeWords, stack, gas, PC and execution counter e+1. The tail uses the same w/cr/ss and proves they survive through actual RETURN.

Fuel chain is consistent: prefix instantiated at f=steps+3 maps X(steps+17) to X(steps+4); CREATE2 step uses steps+3, its child Lambda steps+2 and Context steps+1; initializer resource parameter is steps. Tail executes X(steps+3), with steps>=13 yielding at least 16 fuel for 14 nonhalting instructions plus RETURN. Xi at steps+18 exposes X at steps+17.

Final tuple construction substitutes exact tail world/created/substate equalities and pairs the same w with its initializer-derived Invariant 0. Output is the literal FactoryRuntimeReturn.output memory slice for the canonical address word, not an arbitrary output postcondition.

Strengthening reviewed: InitializerJournalFields.completed is applied to the very hchild tuple produced by JournalGuarantees.initializes, before its eval rewrite. Its input logs and selfDestructSet are definitionally the original a.substate fields through nonce increment/access accounting. The exact tail substate equality transports both fields to the final Xi tuple; no new field-preservation premise is introduced. All original fuel/world composition remains unchanged.

The new hframes uses the retained actual hselected from the same entry_resources witness. JournalChildEntry.selected_lambda_input frames the actual creator nonce-increment world, with factoryAddress!=protectedAddr; its pre-world is definitionally a.world because the concrete prefix only changes machine fields.

InitializerWorldFrame.preserves is applied to that exact child context, Domain and produced hchild, with canonical address equality proving its other-address condition. Its source derives actual initializer execution and literal successful code installation; Exit SSTORE is away from protectedAddr. CodeStorageFrame.trans therefore spans a.world to the same initialized w.

The unchanged complete tail proves its final accountMap=w, so the final Xi result carries this same frame. Neither an arbitrary child post-frame nor a separately chosen successful witness is an input.
assumptions_and_limits: Inputs retain exact factory environment code/calldata/owner and permission, entry gas in [1000000,2^64], steps>=13, creator nonce/value/depth gates, child collision freedom and canonical CREATE2 hash/address equality. These are not yet canonical transaction-admission or deployment-history producers.

The theorem fixes a.env.code and owner, but does not assert lookup of installed factory code from a.world. The parent Theta adapter must bind actual account code selection to that environment; the header correctly lists installed factory as a remaining binding.

This establishes complete pinned Xi success, including its actual factory continuation. It does not establish parent Theta settlement, transaction Upsilon commitment, external ancestor survival, or canonical protocol initialization.
FactoryRuntimeReturn.output remains an explicit memory-write/read expression. This theorem does not separately prove equality to a canonical serialized 20-byte address representation.
No reference Amsterdam instruction/gas correspondence, canonical scheduling/adoption, or global protocol closure is asserted.

InitializerJournalFields is authored by this reviewer; this integration review checks its exact use but does not substitute for independent component review by another author. Its own targeted validation is separate.
